# Version 4.154.0 (Unreleased)
> **Skia m154 cache correction**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.154.0 clears stale GPU cache entries after failed flushes.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **GPU cache entries cleared after failed flushes** — The bundled Skia engine now removes stale Ganesh cache entries when a GPU flush fails, preventing them from affecting later rendering. ([#5253](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5253))
